name: Aurelia, Exemplar of Justice — a white creature gets +2/+0 and vigilance, not trample
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). "gets +2/+0, gains trample if it's red, and gains vigilance if it's white": "if it's red" gated the whole sentence and the vigilance item was dropped, so a white creature got nothing. Each conditional item is now its own rider sentence. Savannah Lions (white 2/1) is 4/1 with vigilance.
